g.text: The Consensus Genome-Scale Metabolic Model of Yeast · µ = 0.0109 h⁻¹
Supplies a heme precursor to the cytoplasm
Ndi1 and Nde1/Nde2 do not pump protons
Pump H+ into the intermembrane space
Produces heme b, heme o and heme a
Interconverts amino acids and folate-bound one-carbon units
Glucose and fructose to pyruvate, ATP and NADH
Sucrose and glucan hydrolysis, glucose uptake
Mdh3 reoxidizes Fox2 NADH and malate carries it out
